Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. We are looking to add a curious, self-motivated engineer to Hadrian’s Autonomous Factory Systems division. This role focuses on developing software interfaces for industrial machinery that mills, welds, forms and more.

The Autonomous Factory Systems team builds the software that gives Hadrian’s factories the ability to sense, decide, and act autonomously. This includes the core robotics stack, orchestration between robots and manufacturing machines, and the hardware abstraction layer that connects our software to the machines on the floor.

* Build data logging pipelines for connected devices that feed operational planning and factory scheduling.
* Collaborate with robotics, engineering, and operations teams to conceptualize, deploy, and upgrade manufacturing cells.

* Strong ability and desire to work directly with hardware on the factory floor.
* Demonstrated ability to make decisions with incomplete information and deliver complex systems on schedule.

Our team has led research teams at nearly every frontier AI labs, and taped out some of the most complex SoCs in the world.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

A placer finishes twice as fast. The router spends the afternoon undoing its choices. Did the new algorithm buy us anything? You’ll have the blocks, the implementation flow, and the freedom to answer that question. Your job is to invent or accelerate physical design flows, tools and algorithms to change how we build chips end to end with AI, with focus on Place, Route, Clock tree, Synthesis, Hand off to Backend, power/timing estimations and over physical convergence.

* **Choose the research problem:** Identify, analyze and size every bottleneck with the physical design team, prioritize them and solve every one. It might be congestion that only becomes visible after routing, or a timing update expensive enough to rule out an otherwise promising search strategy.
* **Build the solver:** Own the algorithm, the flow, measurement and its implementation. That could mean a better objective for placement, an incremental graph update, or a parallel routing kernel. Profile it on real netlists and use what you learn to choose the next experiment.
* **Benchmark the full flow:** Give the incumbent tool a fair run. Match constraints and compute budgets, then follow the result through routing. Measure elapsed time, slack, area, and routability, including on the blocks where your method loses.
* **Put the algorithm/flow into production:** Work alongside the engineer closing the block. Make the solver reproducible, diagnose the corner cases together, and put it into the flow when the gains hold up.

* **Algorithm development:** You’ve implemented an algorithm for placement, routing, timing, or a related EDA problem. A dissertation, open-source tool, or commercial product can all demonstrate that experience.

* Experience working on industry standard tool development for Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens, etc - especially on digital physical design space.

When a part fails on the tester, how/what will we know about it? You’ll shape that answer long before tapeout. You’ll own the test architecture for all our silicons, make the case for the access and observability you need in RTL, and work with the test engineers who bring up the first parts.

* **Drive test signoff:** Own ATPG and DFT signoff. Generate and simulate stuck-at and transition patterns, explain the faults left uncovered, and close on a pattern set that fits the tester memory, test time, and capture power budgets.

-------------------

Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.

Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.

  

**About the role**
------------------

As an Enterprise Solutions Engineer, you partner with your Account Executives to own the technical win across the full sales motion, from deep discovery and architectural solutioning to tailored demos and technical validation. You build relationships with technical champions, co-develop account strategy, and guide large organizations through multi-stakeholder buying committees and long, competitive enterprise sales cycles.

Hightouch sits at the intersection of agentic AI and the maturing cloud data warehouse, and our Solutions Engineering team is still early in building something significant. We run a disciplined value-selling motion, and our SEs earn the technical win rather than assume it.

You'll thrive here if you are curious, have already won competitive enterprise deals, and want to become a product expert and trusted advisor to enterprise buyers. You'll be closing deals independently within six months.

  

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Lead technical discovery to understand a customer's data architecture, marketing workflows, and business objectives, then turn it into differentiated requirements and a solution design that delivers business value.
* Design and deliver tailored demos and architectural solutions across Customer Studio, Identity Resolution, Match Booster, and the Agentic Marketing Platform.
* Run proof-of-concept engagements end to end, from scoping and design to execution and validation, to close complex enterprise deals.
* Build deep technical relationships with data engineers, architects, and marketing technologists as their trusted advisor.
* Navigate complex buying committees, engaging technical teams, marketing leaders, and C-suite executives.
* Advise enterprise customers adopting AI workflows, data activation, and agent-based decisioning, and partner with Product and Engineering to shape the go-to-market strategy for Hightouch's emerging AI and agentic products.
* Use modern AI tooling to improve speed, creativity, and customer impact across the Solutions Engineering workflow.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

You bring 2+ years of enterprise pre-sales or solutions engineering experience, including complex solution architecture across multi-stakeholder buying cycles. Experience in data infrastructure or martech helps.

  

You'll also bring evidence that you can:

* Own the outcome. You carry a technical evaluation from discovery through proof of concept to close, and you're accountable for earning the technical win.
* Learn relentlessly. You pick up products, use cases, and unfamiliar technical topics fast, because how fast you learn matters as much as what you know. You ask for feedback, take it in, and know where you need to grow.
* Bring a point of view. You get curious about messy problems, put structure around them, and back your recommendations with a clear read of the customer's data architecture.
* Create clarity. You lead whiteboarding sessions and turn complex data ecosystems into clear requirements for technical and C-suite audiences, and you say it simply.
* Build trust through partnership. You command and read a room, build technical champions, and partner closely with AEs, Product, and Engineering.
* Adapt and keep moving. You're self-starting, move forward with incomplete information, and stick with hard problems until they're solved. You navigate buying committees and competing vendors, and use new AI tooling to keep getting better.

* *Travel is required for customer and team engagements.*

  

***Strong adds***

* Hands-on experience with CDPs, marketing automation, or data warehouses.
* Experience partnering with data engineering, data science, or analytics teams.
* Time at a high-growth B2B SaaS company through a real inflection point.
* Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Command the Message, or a similar value-selling framework.
